changes.reason: 标普 500 成分股 Paramount Skydance 收购 Warner Bros. Discovery；Twilio 自标普 MidCap 400 调入，于 10 月 6 日开盘前接替（10 月 1 日公告）。
changes.reasonEn: S&P 500 constituent Paramount Skydance is acquiring Warner Bros. Discovery; Twilio moves up from the S&P MidCap 400 to replace it before the open on October 6 (announced October 1).

changes.reason: 分拆种子业务 Vylor 之后，标普认为 Corteva 更能代表中盘股，10 月 6 日开盘前转入标普 MidCap 400（接替 Olin）。
changes.reasonEn: After spinning off its seed business as Vylor, Corteva was deemed more representative of the mid-cap market space and moves to the S&P MidCap 400 (replacing Olin) before the open on October 6.

changes.reason: Corteva 分拆种子业务 Vylor（每股 CTVA 派发 1 股 VYLR），Vylor 于 10 月 1 日起在 NYSE 交易并直接进入标普 500；10 月 6 日起 GICS 行业改为必需消费。
changes.reasonEn: Corteva spun off its seed business as Vylor (one VYLR share per CTVA share); Vylor began trading on the NYSE on October 1 and entered the S&P 500 directly. Its GICS sector changes to Consumer Staples on October 6.

changes.reason: 9 月季度再平衡（9 月 4 日公告，9 月 21 日开盘前生效）：Bloom Energy 自标普 MidCap 400 调入，Molson Coors 调出转入标普 SmallCap 600。
changes.reasonEn: September quarterly rebalance (announced Sept 4, effective before the open on Sept 21): Bloom Energy added from the S&P MidCap 400; Molson Coors Beverage removed to the S&P SmallCap 600.

changes.reason: 9 月季度再平衡（9 月 4 日公告，9 月 21 日开盘前生效）：Everpure（原 Pure Storage，2026 年 4 月改用代码 P）自标普 MidCap 400 调入，The Trade Desk 调出转入标普 SmallCap 600。
